description: Enumerate a domain's subdomains and certificate-issuance history from public Certificate Transparency logs (crt.sh): the names ever certified under it, issuing CAs, and the issuance span. Reveals names even behind a CDN and never touches the target. CT is historical — for a domain that changed hands, older names belong to a previous owner; pass `since` (the current registration date) to exclude them. Read-only.

since.description: Optional cutoff date: a year (2026), year-month (2026-01) or full ISO date (2026-01-26). When set, only names last certified on or after it are returned — use the domain's registration date to exclude a previous owner's names.

name: cert_transparency
